name: Cable Reverse-Grip Triceps Pushdown
steps: Face a high cable and take an underhand grip on the bar with your elbows bent and close to your ribs.
Straighten your elbows and bring the bar in front of your thighs.
Guide the bar back up as your elbows bend.
tips: Keep your wrists aligned with your forearms.
Keep your elbows tucked beside your ribs and avoid leaning over the bar.
